metadata.summary: Sunderland will travel to AC Milan in the Europa League and Bournemouth will host the Serie A giants as Brighton and Hearts discovered their Conference League opponents.
metadata.content: Europa League and Conference League draws: Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton, Hearts learn opponents | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Europa League and Conference League draws: Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton, Hearts learn opponents Celtic, Sunderland, Bournemouth and Crystal Palace will compete in the Europa League; Brighton and Hearts are in the Conference League; Europa League league phase begins on September 15 with Conference League on October 15 Friday 28 August 2026 14:11, UK Sunderland will travel to AC Milan in the Europa League and Bournemouth will host the Serie A giants as Brighton and Hearts discovered their Conference League opponents. The league phase draws for both competitions were made on Friday, with Europa League clubs set to play eight matches while Conference League sides will play six, an equal number home and away, between September 2026 and January 2027. Sunderland reached Europe for the first time in 53 years and will travel to the San Siro to face AC Milan, while Bournemouth , in their first-ever European competition, will host the Italian club. Celtic will host Marseille and travel to Marco Silva's Benfica among their eight Europa League matches, while Crystal Palace, last season's Conference League winners, will host LaLiga side Real Sociedad and visit France's Lyon . messages.text: Mercedes confirm Russell grid penalty - but where will he take it?

metadata.summary: Mercedes have confirmed George Russell will take a grid penalty for exceeding his engine allocation, but are yet to decide which race to serve it at.
metadata.content: George Russell: Mercedes confirm grid penalty but where will British driver take new power unit in 2026 F1 season? | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content George Russell: Mercedes confirm grid penalty but where will British driver take new power unit in 2026 F1 season? George Russell will face a grid drop later this season for a new engine which could damage his championship hopes; Kimi Antonelli will start at the back for the next race in Monza; watch the Italian Grand Prix at Monza live on Sky Sports F1 on September 4-6 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Friday 28 August 2026 11:20, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Speaking on the The F1 Show podcast, Bernie Collins believes Mercedes have 'front-loaded' their upgrades following Toto Wolff admitting his team 'haven't got the money' to match their rivals' upgrades Mercedes have confirmed George Russell will take a grid penalty for exceeding his engine allocation, but are yet to decide which race to serve it at. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli will start at the back of the field at the next Formula 1 race in Italy next weekend, but Russell will also face the same repercussions at a race later this season. Despite having the best car for the majority of this year, both Mercedes drivers have suffered from engine unreliability and will need more than the four allotted power units for this season, thus incurring grid penalties.
